clue.text: Woman will get the bill for coat

parts.note: a woman will is she'll, written without the apostrophe
AC is short for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A woman is handed the bill for a new coat she bought.
explanation.definitionFit: Shellac is a resin varnish brushed on as a protective layer.

clue.text: Oarsman's achievement

definitions.meaning: the rower nearest the stern who sets the pace is called the ...
a feat, as in a ... of genius

explanation.definitionFit: The pacesetting rower shares a name with a notable feat, as in a masterly blow.

clue.text: Stop changes to amber, then green light

indicators.note: the letters of amber change to a new order

parts.note: the green light at a signal means go

explanation.surface: A traffic light turning from amber to green.
explanation.walkthrough: The traffic-light picture makes 'Stop' look like part of it; it is the definition, a ban.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban halting trade.

clue.text: Obtain a superior hired conveyance

parts.note: to land something is to obtain it

explanation.surface: Getting a smart hired carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A landaulet is a small horse-drawn carriage or car with a folding hood.

clue.text: Enter dispute, using bad language about someone's van

indicators.note: the angry words go about, around, the letter taken
van means vanguard, the front, so the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: Arguing and swearing over somebody's delivery van.
explanation.walkthrough: 'van' suggests a vehicle; it is the front, so the first letter, S, goes inside CROSS WORDS.
explanation.definitionFit: To start fighting with blades is the idiom for entering an argument.

clue.text: In fire, save old music-maker

parts.note: to fire someone is to sack them
save in the sense 'except' means but

explanation.surface: A plea to rescue something from a blaze.
explanation.definitionFit: The sackbut is an early form of trombone, a Renaissance instrument.

clue.text: The heads of scillas are dark blue

indicators.note: the heads of the following words are their first letters

explanation.surface: A botanical note that scilla flower heads are dark blue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue' seems part of the flower colour; it means unhappy.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling blue means feeling unhappy.

clue.text: The dog I love is a strange object

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: An odd confession that a beloved dog is a weird thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A curio is an unusual item valued as a curiosity.

clue.text: Happy, not being laid up so much

indicators.note: being signals the one word set within, as if lying in, the other

parts.note: someone laid up is confined to bed
with not before it, not so much means less

explanation.surface: Cheerful because not bedridden so long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not ... so much' means LESS, which goes into BED.
explanation.definitionFit: Blessed means fortunate, as in being content.

clue.text: Value engineers in the army? Of course!

indicators.note: the engineers go in the army

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's reserve force

explanation.surface: Asking whether army engineers are worth anything.
explanation.definitionFit: To treasure something is to prize it highly.

clue.text: Man, an outlaw, in conflict with …

definitions.text: Man, an outlaw, in conflict with …

parts.words: Man, an outlaw, in conflict with
parts.note: read on into the next clue: the legendary Sherwood outlaw forever at odds with the Sheriff of Nottingham

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis carries this clue into 10 across, whose 'sheriff' completes the description; that clue's wordplay is separate.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sherwood Forest bandit of English legend fought the Sheriff of Nottingham.

clue.text: . sheriff concerning woman

parts.note: RE means concerning, as in a memo heading
Eve, the first woman, stands for any woman

explanation.surface: Continuing the legend: a sheriff with a woman in the story.
explanation.walkthrough: The leading dots tie this to 9 across; on its own the clue is a plain charade.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve was a medieval local official; 'sheriff' derives from shire-reeve.

clue.text: Chosen moves are OK

indicators.note: the letters of the words are and OK are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A selected course of action is approved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chosen' looks like a verb meaning picked; it is Choson, the historic name of the peninsula's kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: Choson (Joseon) was the dynastic name of the country, still used for the North.

clue.text: Noticed mounts and stands for skilled workers

explanation.surface: Someone spotted horses and stands meant for craftsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Trestles on which carpenters rest timber for cutting are called by this name.

clue.text: Perversity means holding end up in conflicts

indicators.note: the word for means holds the rest
the turned word sits in the word for conflicts
in a down clue, up means end is read backwards

explanation.surface: Contrariness shown by stopping wars ending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns END to DNE, which goes into WARS to give WARDNES; WAYS holds that.
explanation.definitionFit: Waywardness is stubborn contrariness.

clue.text: Game for loyal party member?

definitions.meaning: a children's game where everyone copies the person in front
a jokey description of a faithful follower who obeys whoever leads the party

explanation.surface: A game suited to a loyal political follower.
explanation.definitionFit: The children's copying game doubles as a phrase for slavish political obedience.

clue.text: About package speak in detail

definitions.note: an adverbial phrase defining an adjective meaning detailed

indicators.note: about means the word for package turns around

parts.note: a bale is a bound package

explanation.surface: Explaining a parcel at length.
explanation.walkthrough: 'speak in detail' reads as the definition, but 'speak' is ORATE; only 'in detail' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Something elaborate is intricate and worked out with much care.

clue.text: Honour — the highest honour with which firm youth is invested

indicators.note: the firm and the youth are invested, clothed, in the card word

parts.note: in cards the ace is the highest honour card
CO is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A prize: the top award conferred on a company's young employee.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the top cards are called honours, and the ace ranks highest.
explanation.definitionFit: An accolade is an award or praise.

clue.text: Set off a carbuncle — note its new setting

indicators.note: the letters of a carbuncle and note are put in a new setting, a fresh order

explanation.surface: Instructions for a jeweller: show off a gem, noting its new mount.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set' and 'setting' suggest jewellery; 'Set off' is the definition, meaning to offset.
explanation.definitionFit: To offset something is to balance it with an equal opposing weight.

clue.text: Young and old, deprived of love, can become wicked

indicators.note: can become says the letters change into a new order
deprived of says the letter for love goes from the pool

parts.note: love is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Young and old, without love, may turn bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Ungodly means sinful, irreligious.

clue.text: Leading Russian and American lawyers a dance

explanation.surface: Russian leaders and American lawyers doing a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The czardas is a Hungarian folk dance.

clue.text: Concern for bird

definitions.meaning: as in not my ..., meaning not my business

explanation.definitionFit: The bird's name is also an idiom for one's business or responsibility.

clue.text: Ran vehicle — one used without a starter

parts.note: an organ is a vehicle in the sense of a medium or mouthpiece
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: used loses its opening letter, its starter

explanation.surface: Someone drove a car that had no starter motor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vehicle' suggests a car, but here it is a medium of communication, as a newspaper is an organ.
explanation.definitionFit: To run an event is to arrange and manage it.

clue.text: Ruth's mother-in-law has one complaint to raise

indicators.note: in a down clue, to raise reads the words one complaint upwards

explanation.surface: A biblical woman with a grievance to air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raise' looks like voicing a complaint; in a down clue it reverses I MOAN.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Book of Ruth, Ruth stays with her husband's mother in Bethlehem.

clue.text: Took a picture including an animal

indicators.note: the words took a picture include the letters within them

explanation.surface: A photographer snapped a shot with an animal in it.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi is a forest relative of the giraffe from central Africa.

clue.text: The sound of Ouida's characters

indicators.note: the characters, or letters, of the name are taken and rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Asking how the characters in the novelist Ouida's books sound.
explanation.walkthrough: Ouida was a Victorian novelist; 'characters' suggests people in her books but signals her name's letters reshuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: Recorded or broadcast sound is called by this term.

clue.text: Empty desk all over the place first, then beat it!

indicators.note: first places the scrambled desk at the front, before the next piece
the letters of desk are scattered all over the place

parts.note: addle as an adjective means empty or barren, as in an addle egg

explanation.surface: Clear the messy desk first, then get out of here!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Empty' looks like a verb telling you to clear the desk; it is the old adjective ADDLE, meaning empty.
explanation.definitionFit: To skedaddle is to run off hastily, the slang order to leave.

clue.text: Star — Basque, by the sound of it

definitions.text: Basque, by the sound of it
definitions.meaning: Basque sounds like bask, which means to lie in the warmth

explanation.surface: A star sounding like a Basque.
explanation.definitionFit: Our star shares its name with a verb meaning to lie in warmth.

clue.text: City doing wrong, harbouring a 7

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

indicators.note: the word for wrongdoing harbours, holds inside it, the letter a

explanation.surface: A city sinning yet sheltering something blessed.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the answer to 7 down, blessed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Elysian Fields were the paradise of the blessed dead in Greek myth.

clue.text: Tramples one of the family

definitions.meaning: tramples means walks heavily upon, two words run together
a spouse's boy from an earlier marriage

explanation.surface: A family member who walks all over others.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as a phrase it means tramples; read as one word, a child by marriage.
